qualification: physical device measurement; single run; not a release gate
device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, CUDA, one device; original HDF5 on a PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD (5.5 GB/s direct-read ceiling)

provenance.owner: private capacity script using only PairedLoader, PairedCounts, detector.prepare

input.source: complete bitshuffle+LZ4 HDF5 masters, 27 shards each

protocol: load the series with a memory-budget admit callback, prepare, run five gesture families of 64 fresh masks twice, verify frozen digests, save forms

rows.measurement: series load, original HDF5 to resident, 64 with the default loader then 5 with the lean tail loader
rows.boundary: first shard read to last source resident
rows.admission: 1.33 GiB per pending source plus 4 GiB (default loader) or 1 GiB (lean tail) against free device memory plus cached pool bytes

rows.measurement: peak device bytes in use, sampled every 20 ms
frozen full-array virtual-image digests (six masks per source) against independent raw-count sums
headless query wall, center gestures, 64 fresh masks
headless query wall, outer gestures, 64 fresh masks
headless query wall, large_jumps gestures, 64 fresh masks
headless query wall, headed_center gestures, 64 fresh masks
headless query wall, scan gestures, 64 fresh masks
save every source as the paired resident form (39 on the root drive, 30 on a second drive)
rows.statistic: sum of per-file write plus fsync

rows.measurement: reopen every saved form through PairedCounts.load, one shared ResidentFileReader per drive (39 on the root NVMe drive, 30 on a second NVMe drive), two threads
rows.boundary: first header read to last source resident
rows.cache_state: files written minutes earlier; direct I/O bypasses the page cache

rows.measurement: device bytes in use after reopening every form (one arena per file)
